title: REALTOXICITYPROMPTS: Evaluating Neural Toxic Degeneration in Language Models
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is the systematic evaluation and mitigation of "toxic" language generation in LMs. Toxicity, including racist and sexist language, is a core ethical issue. The work creates a dataset and "test bed" (REALTOXICITYPROMPTS) specifically to benchmark this unethical behavior in language models. This constitutes a significant component of evaluating the ethical performance of these systems, going far beyond a brief, pro forma ethics statement.
